blocks.zh: 本章學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives for This Section

blocks.zh: 理解最低裝量（Minimum Fill）測試的目的：確保每個容器的裝填量不低於標示量
blocks.en: Understand the purpose of the Minimum Fill test: to ensure that the fill of every container is not less than the labeled amount

blocks.zh: 掌握按重量（by weight）與按體積（by volume）標示產品的不同測試程序
blocks.en: Master the different test procedures for products labeled by weight and products labeled by volume

blocks.zh: 熟悉氣溶膠（aerosols）、噴霧劑（sprays）及泡沫劑（foams）的特殊測試程序
blocks.en: Become familiar with the special test procedures for aerosols, sprays, and foams

blocks.zh: 理解兩階段接受標準（Stage 1 → Stage 2）的統計設計邏輯，以及如何在 GMP 製程中應用
blocks.en: Understand the statistical design logic of the two-stage acceptance criteria (Stage 1 → Stage 2) and how to apply it in a GMP process

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Key Concepts
blocks.en: Key Concepts

blocks.zh: Minimum Fill（最低裝量）：藥品標示量代表患者期望獲得的藥量。如果實際裝量低於標示量，患者可能無法完成完整療程（例如：標示 30 g 的皮膚軟膏，實際只裝了 25 g，患者可能在療程結束前就用完）。〈755〉 的目的就是確保「標示什麼就裝多少」。
blocks.en: Minimum Fill: The labeled amount of a drug product is the quantity the patient expects to receive. If the actual fill is below the labeled amount, the patient may not be able to complete the full course of treatment (for example, a skin ointment labeled 30 g that contains only 25 g may run out before the course ends). The purpose of <755> is to ensure that each container holds what the label says.

blocks.zh: 為何用質量換算體積？液體體積會隨溫度膨脹收縮，而且在充填過程中容易夾帶空氣（entrained air）造成體積虛高。用質量法測量後除以密度換算體積，排除了這些誤差來源，結果更準確可靠。
blocks.en: Why convert volume from mass? The volume of a liquid expands and contracts with temperature, and entrained air picked up during filling can make the volume appear higher than it is. Measuring by mass and dividing by density to obtain volume removes these sources of error, so the result is more accurate and reliable.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy
blocks.en: Analogy

blocks.zh: 想像你去超市買一罐標示「淨重 500 g」的蜂蜜。你回家後把蜂蜜倒出來，把瓶子洗乾淨，然後秤空瓶重量，再用差減法算出裡面實際的蜂蜜重量。這正是 〈755〉 的核心測試邏輯——秤裝填前後的重量差（net weight by difference）。USP 連容器怎麼清洗、標籤要不要先撕掉，都有詳細規定，因為這些都會影響秤重的準確性。
blocks.en: Imagine buying a jar of honey labeled "net weight 500 g" at the supermarket. At home you pour out the honey, wash the jar, weigh the empty jar, and then calculate the actual weight of honey by difference. This is exactly the core test logic of <755>: weighing the difference before and after filling (net weight by difference). USP even specifies in detail how to clean the container and whether to remove the label first, because these all affect weighing accuracy.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Notes
blocks.en: Key Notes

blocks.zh: 適用劑型的廣泛性：〈755〉 不只適用於注射劑——它覆蓋乳膏（creams）、凝膠（gels）、洗劑（lotions）、軟膏（ointments）、糊劑（pastes）、散劑（powders）、氣溶膠（aerosols）、泡沫劑（foams）和噴霧劑（sprays）。這些劑型在 CDMO 業務中非常常見，特別是半固體（semi-solid）外用製劑的充填線。
blocks.en: Broad range of applicable dosage forms: <755> is not limited to injections. It covers creams, gels, lotions, ointments, pastes, powders, aerosols, foams, and sprays. These dosage forms are very common in CDMO business, especially on filling lines for semi-solid topical products.

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 為什麼按體積標示的產品要用質量法測定再換算體積，而不是直接用量筒量體積？哪些因素使直接量體積不夠準確？
blocks.en: Why is a product labeled by volume tested by mass and then converted to volume, rather than measuring the volume directly in a graduated cylinder? Which factors make a direct volume measurement insufficiently accurate?

blocks.zh: Procedure for Dosage Forms Other Than Aerosols, Sprays, and Foams | 非氣溶膠劑型之試驗程序
blocks.en: Procedure for Dosage Forms Other Than Aerosols, Sprays, and Foams

blocks.zh: Net Weight by Difference（差減法求淨重）：這是最基本但最重要的操作邏輯：
blocks.en: Net Weight by Difference: This is the most basic but most important operating logic:

blocks.zh: 步驟 1：稱帶蓋的裝填容器（gross weight）
blocks.en: Step 1: Weigh the filled container with its closure (gross weight)

blocks.zh: 步驟 2：完全移除內容物後，稱空容器+蓋子
blocks.en: Step 2: After completely removing the contents, weigh the empty container plus closure

blocks.zh: 步驟 3：淨重 = 步驟 1 − 步驟 2
blocks.en: Step 3: Net weight = Step 1 − Step 2

blocks.zh: 關鍵細節：蓋子（closure）和所有附件在初始秤重和空容器秤重時都必須保留——否則差減法的結果就不準確。
blocks.en: Key detail: The closure and all accessories must be kept in place for both the initial weighing and the empty-container weighing; otherwise the result of the difference calculation will not be accurate.

blocks.zh: 密度計算公式：密度（ρ） = W（樣品重量） / V（佔用體積），其中 V = 50.0 mL − 補入的可混溶液體體積。這個巧妙的方法利用定容量瓶（100 mL）作為工具，精確測定樣品在混合液中的佔用體積。
blocks.en: Density formula: Density (ρ) = W (sample weight) / V (volume occupied), where V = 50.0 mL − volume of miscible liquid added. This clever method uses a volumetric flask (100 mL) as the tool to determine precisely the volume the sample occupies in the mixture.

blocks.zh: 公式與計算 Formula
blocks.en: Formula & Calculation

blocks.zh:
密度測定（Density Determination）：

Setup: 100-mL volumetric flask
  + 50.0 mL miscible liquid (tared)
  + ~25 mL sample (weighed: W grams)
  + miscible liquid to 100 mL mark
    (volume added from burette: x mL)

Calculation:
  V = 50.0 - x  (volume displaced by sample)
  ρ = W / V  (g/mL)

Volume-Labeled Product:
  Net Volume = Net Weight / ρ

Example:
  Net Weight = 24.50 g
  ρ = 0.98 g/mL
  Net Volume = 24.50 / 0.98 = 25.0 mL
blocks.en:
Density Determination:

Setup: 100-mL volumetric flask
  + 50.0 mL miscible liquid (tared)
  + ~25 mL sample (weighed: W grams)
  + miscible liquid to 100 mL mark
    (volume added from burette: x mL)

Calculation:
  V = 50.0 - x  (volume displaced by sample)
  ρ = W / V  (g/mL)

Volume-Labeled Product:
  Net Volume = Net Weight / ρ

Example:
  Net Weight = 24.50 g
  ρ = 0.98 g/mL
  Net Volume = 24.50 / 0.98 = 25.0 mL

blocks.zh: 密度測定的方法就像阿基米德的排水原理翻版。你把樣品加入已知體積的容器中，再補入液體直到回到原刻度，補入的液體量就代表樣品「佔走了」多少空間。用樣品重量除以它佔據的體積，就得到密度。這個方法的優點是不需要特殊設備，只需要精密天平和一個量瓶就能完成，適合半固體或高黏度物料（直接用比重計不適合）。
blocks.en: The density method is essentially a variation of Archimedes' displacement principle. You add the sample to a vessel of known volume, then top up with liquid until the original mark is reached; the amount of liquid added shows how much space the sample "took up". Dividing the sample weight by the volume it occupies gives the density. The advantage of this method is that no special equipment is needed: only an analytical balance and a volumetric flask, and it suits semi-solid or highly viscous materials (for which a direct hydrometer is unsuitable).

blocks.zh: 標籤必須先去除：USP 明確要求移除可能在去除容器內容物時影響重量的標籤（labeling）。實際操作中，有些標籤含有印刷油墨或黏膠，在溶劑清洗過程中可能溶解並改變容器重量——這個細節在 SOP 中常被忽略，卻是測試準確性的關鍵。
blocks.en: Labels must be removed first: USP explicitly requires removal of any labeling that could affect the weight when the contents of the container are removed. In practice, some labels contain printing ink or adhesive that may dissolve during solvent rinsing and change the container weight. This detail is often overlooked in SOPs, yet it is critical to test accuracy.

blocks.zh: 「Quantitatively remove」的要求：「定量移除」意味著必須盡量完全去除容器內所有內容物（可用適當溶劑清洗），不能殘留。對於高黏度軟膏或凝膠，這一步需要明確的洗滌溶劑選擇和操作步驟，並在方法驗證中確認回收率。
blocks.en: The "quantitatively remove" requirement: "Quantitatively remove" means the contents of the container must be removed as completely as possible (rinsing with a suitable solvent is permitted), leaving no residue. For highly viscous ointments or gels, this step requires a clearly defined choice of rinsing solvent and operating steps, with recovery confirmed during method validation.

blocks.zh: 在測試一個標示「30 mL」的乳膏時，某一容器的淨重為 30.6 g，但密度為 0.98 g/mL，計算實際體積。這個結果符合標示量嗎？
blocks.en: When testing a cream labeled "30 mL", the net weight of one container is 30.6 g and the density is 0.98 g/mL. Calculate the actual volume. Does this result meet the labeled amount?

blocks.zh: USP 提供了量筒直接量體積（graduated cylinder）作為替代方法。這個替代方法與質量法相比有哪些優缺點？在什麼情況下您會選擇量筒法？
blocks.en: USP offers direct measurement of volume in a graduated cylinder as an alternative method. What are the advantages and disadvantages of this alternative compared with the mass method? Under what circumstances would you choose the graduated cylinder method?

blocks.zh: Acceptance Criteria — Non-Aerosol Products (Two-Stage) | 接受標準：非氣溶膠產品（兩階段）
blocks.en: Acceptance Criteria: Non-Aerosol Products (Two-Stage)

blocks.zh: NLT（Not Less Than，不少於）與 NMT（Not More Than，不多於）：USP 的標準縮寫，在法規解讀中至關重要。NLT = ≥（大於或等於）；NMT = ≤（小於或等於）。
blocks.en: NLT (Not Less Than) and NMT (Not More Than): These are standard USP abbreviations and are essential when interpreting regulations. NLT = ≥ (greater than or equal to); NMT = ≤ (less than or equal to).

blocks.zh: 兩階段測試設計的邏輯：Stage 1 用 10 個容器快速篩選。如果結果明顯合格，省下額外 20 個容器的測試成本。只有在邊界情況（1 個容器不合格）時，才進入 Stage 2 擴大樣本。這是一個平衡「消費者風險（Consumer Risk）」與「生產者風險（Producer Risk）」的統計抽樣設計。
blocks.en: Logic of the two-stage test design: Stage 1 uses 10 containers for a quick screen. If the results clearly pass, the cost of testing the additional 20 containers is saved. Only in a borderline case (1 container fails) does testing proceed to Stage 2 with an enlarged sample. This is a statistical sampling design that balances consumer risk against producer risk.

blocks.zh: 60 g / 60 mL 分界線：小包裝（≤60 g 或 mL）允許更大的個別容器偏差（最低至 90%），因為小包裝在充填技術上本就存在更大的相對誤差。大包裝（>60 g 或 mL）要求更嚴格（最低至 95%），因為大包裝的充填設備通常具有更高精度，而且大量包裝的絕對重量偏差影響更大。
blocks.en: The 60 g / 60 mL dividing line: Small packages (≤60 g or mL) allow a larger deviation for individual containers (down to 90%), because small fills inherently carry a larger relative error in filling technology. Large packages (>60 g or mL) are held to a stricter limit (down to 95%), because the filling equipment for large packages is usually more precise, and the absolute weight deviation of a large fill has a greater impact.

blocks.zh: 公式與計算 Formula — Stage 1 Decision Tree
blocks.en: Formula & Calculation: Stage 1 Decision Tree

blocks.zh: 兩階段測試就像台灣高考的備取制度。第一輪放榜（Stage 1，10 個容器）：絕大多數批次直接通過。少數邊界情況進入第二輪（Stage 2，再加 20 個，共 30 個）——擴大樣本讓統計結論更可靠，減少因為「剛好抽到 1 個不好的容器」就判定整批失敗的機率。但如果 Stage 2 還是不過，批次就真的不合格了。
blocks.en: The two-stage test is like the reserve-list system of Taiwan's civil service exams. In the first round of results (Stage 1, 10 containers), the vast majority of batches pass outright. A few borderline cases move on to the second round (Stage 2, 20 more containers for a total of 30). The larger sample makes the statistical conclusion more reliable and reduces the chance of failing an entire batch merely because "one bad container happened to be drawn". But if the batch still fails at Stage 2, it truly fails.

blocks.zh: Stage 1 失敗條件（直接 FAIL，不進 Stage 2）：如果 ≥ 2 個容器低於閾值，或平均值低於 100% 標示量，則直接判定不合格，不需要進入 Stage 2。只有當「平均值合格，但恰好有 1 個容器低於閾值」時，才進入 Stage 2 做更大樣本的判斷。
blocks.en: Stage 1 failure conditions (outright FAIL, no Stage 2): If ≥ 2 containers fall below the threshold, or the average is below 100% of the labeled amount, the batch is judged to fail directly and does not proceed to Stage 2. Only when "the average passes but exactly 1 container is below the threshold" does testing proceed to Stage 2 for a decision on a larger sample.

blocks.zh: 與 ICH Q6A 及其他充填量測試的關係：〈755〉 適用於非無菌外用製劑和半固體製劑。注射劑的裝量差異（fill volume uniformity）受 〈1〉（Injections and Implanted Drug Products）管轄；片劑重量差異受 〈2091〉（Weight Variation）管轄。了解哪個章節適用於哪種劑型，是 QC 和法規事務的基礎知識。
blocks.en: Relationship to ICH Q6A and other fill-quantity tests: <755> applies to non-sterile topical and semi-solid preparations. Fill volume uniformity of injections is governed by <1> (Injections and Implanted Drug Products), and tablet weight variation is governed by <2091> (Weight Variation). Knowing which chapter applies to which dosage form is basic knowledge for QC and regulatory affairs.

blocks.zh: 某批次 100 g 乳膏（大包裝，適用 95% 下限），Stage 1 結果：平均裝量 = 101.5 g，最低 1 個容器 = 93 g（93%），其餘 9 個均 ≥ 98 g。這批次結果應如何判定？需要進入 Stage 2 嗎？
blocks.en: For a batch of 100 g cream (a large package, so the 95% lower limit applies), the Stage 1 results are: average fill = 101.5 g, the lowest 1 container = 93 g (93%), and the other 9 are all ≥ 98 g. How should this batch be judged? Is Stage 2 required?

blocks.zh: 如果某批次在 Stage 1 就已有 2 個容器低於 90% 下限（標示量 50 g），即便平均值仍大於 50 g，這批次是否還能進入 Stage 2 補救？為什麼？
blocks.en: If a batch already has 2 containers below the 90% lower limit at Stage 1 (labeled amount 50 g), can it still proceed to Stage 2 as a remedy, even if the average is still above 50 g? Why or why not?

blocks.zh: Procedure for Aerosols, Sprays, and Foams | 氣溶膠、噴霧劑與泡沫劑之試驗程序
blocks.en: Procedure for Aerosols, Sprays, and Foams

blocks.zh: 氣溶膠的特殊程序：氣溶膠罐（aerosol container）含有加壓推進劑（propellant），不能像軟膏一樣直接打開倒出。USP 規定的安全操作步驟是：先冷卻降低內部壓力 → 移除閥門（valve）→ 傾倒內容物 → 用甲醇（methanol）沖洗殘留物 → 在 100°C 烘烤 5 分鐘確保完全乾燥。
blocks.en: Special procedure for aerosols: An aerosol container holds a pressurized propellant and cannot simply be opened and emptied like an ointment container. The safe operating steps specified by USP are: chill to reduce the internal pressure → remove the valve → pour out the contents → rinse the residue with methanol → dry at 100°C for 5 minutes to ensure complete dryness.

blocks.zh: 為什麼要保留閥門和所有附件？因為初始秤重時已包含了閥門重量，如果空罐秤重時移除了閥門，差減法計算的「淨充填重量」就會被高估。閥門、密封圈等所有在初始秤重時存在的零件，都必須在空罐秤重時原封不動地保留。
blocks.en: Why keep the valve and all accessories? The valve weight is already included in the initial weighing. If the valve is removed when the empty container is weighed, the "net fill weight" from the difference calculation will be overestimated. The valve, seals, and all other parts present at the initial weighing must be left intact when the empty container is weighed.

blocks.zh: 氣溶膠接受標準更嚴格——每個容器都必須達標：非氣溶膠產品允許用平均值補救（平均值 NLT 標示量，最多 1 個容器低於閾值），但氣溶膠、噴霧劑和泡沫劑的標準是：每一個容器（each container）的淨充填重量都必須 NLT 標示量——沒有例外，也沒有第二階段。
blocks.en: Aerosol acceptance criteria are stricter: every container must comply. Non-aerosol products allow the average to compensate (average NLT the labeled amount, with at most 1 container below the threshold). For aerosols, sprays, and foams, however, the requirement is that the net fill weight of each and every container must be NLT the labeled amount, with no exceptions and no second stage.

blocks.zh: 為何氣溶膠標準更嚴格？因為氣溶膠產品（如哮喘吸入劑）的充填量直接關係到每次給藥的劑量準確性（dose uniformity）。每次使用都必須提供足夠的藥量，不能靠「平均值合格」來掩蓋個別容器裝填不足的問題。
blocks.en: Why is the aerosol standard stricter? For aerosol products (such as asthma inhalers), the fill quantity bears directly on the dose uniformity of each administration. Every use must deliver a sufficient amount of drug, and a passing average cannot be allowed to mask underfilling in individual containers.

blocks.zh: 100°C 烘烤 5 分鐘的目的：驅除甲醇沖洗後的殘留溶劑，確保空罐秤重的準確性。如果殘留甲醇沒有完全揮發，空罐重量偏高，計算出的淨充填重量就會偏低，可能造成假性不合格。
blocks.en: Purpose of drying at 100°C for 5 minutes: To drive off residual solvent after the methanol rinse and ensure the accuracy of the empty-container weight. If residual methanol has not fully evaporated, the empty container weighs more, the calculated net fill weight comes out too low, and a false failure may result.

blocks.zh: 氣溶膠測試就像拆解一枚「迷你壓力鍋」。你不能直接打開（有壓力，危險），必須先讓它「冷靜下來」（冷卻降壓），再小心拆開閥門，把裡面的東西清空、沖乾淨、烘乾，最後秤空殼重量。整個過程中，所有的零件（閥門、密封環、噴嘴）都必須完整保留，才能確保計算的淨重是真實的充填量。
blocks.en: Testing an aerosol is like taking apart a "miniature pressure cooker". You cannot simply open it (it is under pressure and dangerous). You must first let it "calm down" (chill to reduce the pressure), then carefully remove the valve, empty out the contents, rinse it clean, dry it, and finally weigh the empty shell. Throughout the process, all parts (valve, sealing ring, nozzle) must be kept intact so that the calculated net weight is the true fill.

blocks.zh: 實務應用 Practical Application
blocks.en: Practical Application

blocks.zh: 對 CDMO 製造氣溶膠或定量吸入器（Metered Dose Inhaler, MDI）的場景：〈755〉 的最低裝量測試是批次放行的必要測試之一，但它測量的是整罐的總充填量（total fill weight），而非每次揿壓的劑量均一性（dose uniformity per actuation）。後者由 〈601〉 Aerosols 或 〈905〉 Uniformity of Dosage Units 管轄。這兩個測試的目的不同，必須同時滿足才能完整保障產品品質。
blocks.en: For a CDMO manufacturing aerosols or metered dose inhalers (MDIs): the <755> Minimum Fill test is one of the required tests for batch release, but it measures the total fill weight of the whole canister, not the dose uniformity per actuation. The latter is governed by <601> Aerosols or <905> Uniformity of Dosage Units. The two tests serve different purposes, and both must be met to fully assure product quality.

blocks.zh: 某批次哮喘吸入劑（標示 200 次揿壓量），10 罐測試結果：9 罐淨充填重量均在 98%–103% 標示量之間，但第 3 罐僅有 99.2%——如果這些是 >60 g 的非氣溶膠產品，這批次如何判定？若這是氣溶膠產品，判定結果有何不同？
blocks.en: For a batch of asthma inhalers (labeled 200 actuations), in a 10-canister test 9 canisters have net fill weights between 98% and 103% of the labeled amount, but canister 3 has only 99.2%. If these were non-aerosol products of >60 g, how would the batch be judged? If this is an aerosol product, how does the judgment differ?

blocks.zh: 為什麼氣溶膠的接受標準要求「每個容器都 NLT 100% 標示量」，而非氣溶膠產品則允許「平均值 NLT 標示量，個別容器 NLT 90% 或 95%」？從患者安全的角度解釋這種差異的合理性。
blocks.en: Why do the acceptance criteria for aerosols require "every container NLT 100% of the labeled amount", while non-aerosol products allow "average NLT the labeled amount, individual containers NLT 90% or 95%"? Explain from a patient safety perspective why this difference is reasonable.

blocks.zh: Complete Overview — USP 〈755〉 Minimum Fill Summary | 完整概覽
blocks.en: Complete Overview: USP <755> Minimum Fill Summary

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧 Section Summary
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: 〈755〉 最低裝量測試確保每個容器的實際充填量符合標示量，適用於乳膏、凝膠、軟膏、散劑、氣溶膠等多種劑型
blocks.en: The <755> Minimum Fill test ensures that the actual fill of each container meets the labeled amount, and applies to many dosage forms such as creams, gels, ointments, powders, and aerosols

blocks.zh: 非氣溶膠產品採用兩階段測試（Stage 1：10 個容器；Stage 2：再加 20 個，共 30 個），平均值必須 NLT 100% 標示量
blocks.en: Non-aerosol products use a two-stage test (Stage 1: 10 containers; Stage 2: 20 more, for a total of 30), and the average must be NLT 100% of the labeled amount

blocks.zh: 按重量標示產品的個別容器下限：≤60 g 為 90%，>60 g 為 95%；按體積標示者先換算密度後套用相同標準
blocks.en: Individual container lower limits for products labeled by weight: 90% for ≤60 g and 95% for >60 g; for products labeled by volume, convert using density first and then apply the same criteria

blocks.zh: 氣溶膠、噴霧劑和泡沫劑採用嚴格的一次性標準：每個容器淨充填重量都必須 NLT 100% 標示量，無兩階段設計
blocks.en: Aerosols, sprays, and foams use a strict single-stage criterion: the net fill weight of every container must be NLT 100% of the labeled amount, with no two-stage design

blocks.zh: 氣溶膠特殊操作：冷卻降壓 → 移除閥門 → 甲醇沖洗 → 100°C/5 min 烘乾 → 差減法求淨充填重量
blocks.en: Special aerosol handling: chill to reduce pressure → remove valve → methanol rinse → dry at 100°C/5 min → net fill weight by difference
